description: Acid-loving berry shrub of temperate regions, grown in India only on a small scale in the hills and in pot or protected culture using low-chill varieties. It needs very acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5) rich in organic matter and good drainage.
npk_split: For mature bushes: split into 2-3 doses from bud break to fruit set, using ammonium sulphate and sulphate of potash (not nitrate or chloride forms), and adjust P and K by soil test.

healthy.name: Healthy
healthy.description: The leaf shows no sign of disease, pest or deficiency. Yellowing between green veins on new leaves usually means the soil is not acidic enough, so check soil pH regularly.
symptoms: No yellowing between the veins on young leaves
healthy.spread: Not applicable - no disease or pest detected.
healthy.action: Keep the soil acidic and mulched, water regularly and scout the plants every week.
